entities.summary: Judith Gail Biggert is an American politician and attorney. She is the former U.S. representative for Illinois's 13th congressional district, serving from 1999 to 2013. She is a member of the Republican Party. Judy Biggert was a legal figures from Chicago (b. 1937-08-15, Chicago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
